message.content:
Soft, breathable merino wool-blend top, relaxed fit, crew neck, heather grey, hex #D3D3D3, lightweight knit fabric.  
Elastic-waist tapered jogger pants, straight leg with side pockets, charcoal grey, hex #36454F, stretch cotton-spandex blend.  
Minimalist canvas slip-on sneakers, low profile sole, off-white, hex #FAFAFA, durable synthetic upper.  
This outfit works perfectly for a morning yoga session because the natural fibers of the top manage temperature fluctuations typical of autumn mornings while maintaining comfort during movement. The dark trousers provide a sleek, everyday look that transitions easily from the studio to a casual walk afterward without feeling too dressed up or too sloppy. By avoiding restrictive layers, the ensemble allows for full range of motion required in yoga poses while adhering to her preference for home and everyday casual styles.
